items.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued October 21 at 3:09PM AKDT until October 26 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Significant coastal flooding possible. Water levels 5 to
8 feet above the normal high tide line possible.

* WHERE...Southern Seward Peninsula Coast.

* WHEN...From late Thursday night through late Sunday night.

* IMPACTS...Low lying property including homes, businesses, and
some critical infrastructure may be inundated. Some shoreline
erosion may occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Strong south to southeast winds increase
Friday morning with gusts up to 65 mph possible.
items.instruction:
If travel is required, allow extra time as some roads may be
closed. Do not drive around barricades or through water of
unknown depth. Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone
property.
